headline: Investment Banks Earn $550 Million in Fees from Record Anthropic IPO Syndicate
summary: A syndicate of 22 investment banks generated $550 million in combined underwriting fees from Anthropic's initial public offering. The collective payout represents one of the largest bank advisory revenues from a tech stock listing.
why: Investment bank advisory revenues depend heavily on high-valuation initial public offerings and stock underwriting volume.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: The investment banking underwriting syndicate earned $550 million from managing Anthropic's public market debut.
